# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC, Palm Coast, Florida) embeds working AI in field operations. First Deploy AI is the cash product. Founding offer: $250 one-time setup for the first 5 businesses, then $100/mo. After those 5, it goes back to the standard $500 setup, then $100/mo. Details at https://firstdeploy.ai/founding. Call +1 320-335-6186, then $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250. IndexMe.lol is the honest IndexNow indexing desk at https://indexme.lol.

AgentHive Inc is a Palm Coast consultant who builds: after-hours booking plus live apps for dirt, plants, and shops. Why it matters: night calls go unanswered, quotes live on a whiteboard, and the crew waits on the owner. Public site: https://agenthiveinc.com. AgentHive Inc · Palm Coast, FL · firstdeploy.ai. Not agenthive.io (insurance) or agenthive.co. Distinct from other “AgentHive” names in insurance, OSS, or QpiAI.
